entry.name: pattrmarker
entry.description: The pattrmarker object associates a patcher with a global name, which can be used when looking up named objects. This permits, among other conveniences, name lookup and communication between two or more independent patcher hierarchies.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: The name for the parent patcher of theobject in theglobal namespace.

messages.name: getmarkerlist
messages.description: Reports a list of all registered names in theglobal namespace from theobject's outlet, prepended by the word. These names are reported whether they were registered viaobjects or via theattribute of theobject. With no argument, or an argument of, the names ofobjects with theattribute enabledappear in the reported list. With an argument of, all names, regardless of thestatus, will be reported.
